pages.title: A Flame With Demands
pages.text: Right-click a Treacherous Candle with flint and steel, and obtain a Treacherous Flame.

pages.title: A Flame With Demands
pages.text: Follow a native Nether progression without receiving its key reward for free.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find the relevant sanctum using the native locator, prepare the candle and follow its actual rules. The click and owned flame are checked; the journal neither creates the flame nor proves a ritual by a click alone.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: In a Sanctum, light the Treacherous Candle and defend it under native rules. A flame unlocks a Brazier Chest; its artifact core supports Shotgun Fist crafting and a smithing template/flame upgrades it. The defense is not proved by a click.
